_note: Per-document overrides, keyed by source filename.
'pages' extracts a page range instead of publishing the whole file. Used for
manuals bound in several languages: the reader only wants one of them, and the
other seven multiply the download for nothing.

mitsubishi--msz-ln-brochure.pdf.why: The same 24-page 'For your luxury' brochure that was already published by hand at this filename, only compressed (5.7 MB -> 3.5 MB). Forcing the name keeps the URL that has been live working and stops the page listing the document twice.

PRODUCT_CATALOGUE_International-Markets_.why: Beretta's general international-markets catalogue, not a Quadra Green brochure -- it only sits in that model's folder. 57.8 MB, and 27.7 MB even after compression, because its pages are already efficiently-compressed imagery. Link to Beretta's own download page instead, per the decision to link out rather than host the large catalogues.

MYNUTE S 35 C-S-I- NG-20069392-Installer.why: 144 pages in eight languages. English runs 1-17 (FRANÇAIS starts on 18) and the shared figures and wiring diagrams run 118-144; the 100 pages between are FR/ES/PT/HU/RO/DE/SL. Verified by reading the language header on each boundary page.
